トレーラーハウスを公道で移動させる際には、車両の構造、寸法、重量、制動装置等に応: When moving a trailer house on public roads, it is important to confirm the necessary procedures—such as vehicle inspection, relaxation certification of the safety standards, and special-vehicle passage permits—according to the vehicle’s structure, dimensions, weight, braking system, and so on.

3. 車両総重量3.5トンとO2・O3カテゴリー: 3. Gross vehicle weight of 3.5 tons and the O2/O3 categories

In particular, for trailer houses exceeding 3.5 tons, a general inertia-brake system alone may be insufficient to meet the standards, so confirming the vehicle structure, including the braking system, becomes important.
O2・O3は国際的な車両分類であり、この区分だけで日本国内の車検・登録の可否が決: O2 and O3 are international vehicle classifications, and this distinction alone does not determine whether vehicle inspection and registration are possible within Japan. A gross vehicle weight exceeding 3.5 tons alone does not uniformly make inspection and registration impossible.

日本建築行政会議「建築確認のための基準総則・集団規定の適用事例」の2026年版で: In the 2026 edition of the Japan Conference of Building Administration’s “Application Examples of General Standards and Collective Regulations for Building Confirmation,” the treatment of trailer houses and similar vehicles was reorganized and expanded. Please review it together with Okinawa Prefecture’s handling standards. The following is an excerpt of the key points and is not the text of the law itself. For individual decisions and the latest practice, please check with the relevant administrative authority in advance.
2026年版のおもな追記・変更: Main additions and changes in the 2026 edition
対象として「キッチンカー」が新たに明記され、バス・キャンピングカー・トレーラーハ: “Kitchen cars” (mobile food trucks) were newly listed as covered vehicles, and buses, camping cars, and trailer houses, etc. were reorganized as “things premised on being moved.”
屋内的利用を行うもののうち、随時かつ任意に移動できるとは認められないもの、又は継: Among those used for indoor purposes, it was clarified that any that cannot be recognized as movable at any time and at will, or that are used while being continuously kept in place, are treated as buildings.
設備配線・配管の着脱式は、「一般家庭にある工具等を使用して取り外しができるもの」: The definition of “detachable” connections for utility wiring and piping was clarified as “removable using tools commonly found in an ordinary household.”
「移動できるとは認められないもの」の例に、クレーン等がないと設置も撤去もできない: Added to the examples of “things not recognized as movable”: those that cannot be installed or removed without a crane, that cannot be moved by a towing vehicle alone, or that are in an immovable state due to installation in a location where turning around is impossible.
同じく、進行方向に固定された障害物があるものが例として追加されました。: Likewise, those with a fixed obstacle in their direction of travel were added as an example.
「随時かつ任意に移動できると認められるもの」の例が新設され、移動販売等で一定の期: A new category of examples for “things recognized as movable at any time and at will” was established, with cases such as mobile sales that are set up periodically at intervals without becoming a continuous installation given as an applicable example.
随時かつ任意に移動できる状態であっても、店舗等として継続的に滞留して使用する場合: Even in a state where it can be moved at any time and at will, if it is used while being continuously kept in place as a store or the like, it is considered to be fixed to the land and to fall under the definition of a building.
災害対応のために被災地で使われるものであっても、平常時の使用にあたり土地への定着: Even those used in disaster-stricken areas for disaster response are treated as buildings when, for example, fixation to the land is recognized in their ordinary use.
少なくとも1週間程度のイベント等のために設置するもので、随時かつ任意に移動できる: Those installed for events lasting about one week at most, which can be moved at any time and at will, may be treated as vehicles without problem.
車検証、臨時運行許可（仮ナンバー）や特殊車両通行許可等は、車両として適法に公道を: A vehicle inspection certificate, temporary operation permit (temporary number plate), special-vehicle passage permit, and the like are things naturally required for a vehicle to lawfully travel on public roads; merely having obtained them does not allow a determination that the unit is “movable at any time and at will.”
